title: Feel the energy — arena display sequence
slide_intent: Coordinate adjacent displays so a viewer can connect a message across an architectural setting.
strategic_value: Alternating O2 signatures with performance imagery can link the network identity to the energy of live events.
demonstration: A row of tall illuminated arena displays alternates blue gradient O2 panels with performance photographs carrying the separate words Feel, the and energy.
practical_value: Distribute a short phrase across linked screens while retaining recognizable brand panels between the images.

content_islands.name: Arena setting
content_islands.spec: Preserve the perspective view of the suspended display row and its structural supports.

content_islands.name: Alternating panels
content_islands.spec: Alternate O2 gradient-and-bubble panels with dark performance images, placing one word of the phrase on each image panel.

reference_purposes.Expression: Blue gradient brand panels share the scene with saturated live-performance photography.
reference_purposes.Application: The identity and phrase are arranged across multiple tall displays in an arena environment.
